items.issue: Accurate and well-written. First sentence stands alone, correctly describes the always-succeeding Some(x) extraction, uses backticks and a wiki-style [[scala.Some]] link, and the @tparam/@param wording ('the type of the Nth element of the product') matches the terminology already used by the enclosing trait Product9's own Scaladoc ('the type of the 1st element') and by Product.scala's productElement docs.

The first sentence already says 'Returns the given product wrapped in a [[scala.Some]]', which fully states the return value, so per the stated convention ('@return is dropped only when the description begins with Returns and already fully states the return') the trailing `@return `Some(x)`` tag is redundant. Minor — some sibling Product-N files in this same PR keep an analogous @return line, so this is a style nit rather than an error.
